displayName: Mercado Libre Product Data API - Search, Products, Reviews, Questions, Best Sellers
description: Mercado Libre product data as structured JSON for Mexico, Brazil (Mercado Livre), Argentina and Colombia - keyword or seller search with price, discount, installments, shipping and sponsored flags, one product with the buy-box seller and star distribution, product reviews, buyer questions with seller answers, and the top 20 best sellers in a category. 5 endpoints, 1-2 credits each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
